Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sending the initial docs.

Couple quick asks so we can get procurement + finance to action this without delay:
- Confirm legal entity exact name for vendor record (as it should appear on contracts and 1099s).
- Confirm EIN for Harbor Fabrics US, Inc. (we need it for the vendor profile).
- Confirm whether you want the old vendor number (HF-349) retired or kept as an alias. We typically keep the original ID for historical PO/invoice mapping unless you prefer a hard swap.
- Confirm the remittance mailing address (we'll update both portal and AP system).
- Confirm portal admin: if Susan Meyer is the right admin, we'll send an invite and transfer ownership.

I've looped in Lauren (procurement operations) to run the vendor-update and Vivek from payments to schedule micro-deposit verification on the new account.

Two attachments we need from you if available: incorporation certificate for the consolidated entity and a scanned copy of the EIN letter (or a screenshot from the gov portal). The W-9 looks fine as submitted.

Once we have those pieces, procurement will:
1) Update vendor master (vendor portal + ERP) and keep a change log.
2) Flag HF-349 with an alias to the consolidated entity as requested.
3) Finance runs micro-deposits (expected 1-3 business days) and then flip remittance routing for new POs.

If you want the change to be effective 2027-01-01, please confirm no POs will be issued to the old bank between now and then or tell us if you need a hard cutoff.

-Karthik
